title: 3-on-3 Transition Game
description: A continuous full-court 3-on-3 game where every change of possession becomes an immediate attack or a sprint back, building transition habits under game pressure.

content.objective: Play with pace: push the ball after every stop, sprint back after every score, and make quick decisions with a small number of players.
content.setup: Two teams of three on the full court, extra teams waiting at the baseline. The game is continuous: after any made basket, missed basket or turnover the team on offence must attack immediately.
content.organization: Winners stay on. A team that scores stays as offence; the waiting team enters as defenders for the next possession.
instructions: Team A attacks against team B. Play until a score, a defensive stop or a turnover.
On a change of possession the new offence pushes the ball up the court at once; the new defence sprints back.
After a score the next team from the sideline enters as the new defence from the far baseline.
Play games to five points, or two three-minute rounds, and rotate the winners.
Award a bonus point for a basket scored in fewer than eight seconds.
coachingPoints: First pass or first dribble goes forward; a forward pass beats a dribble.
The defence protects the basket first and then finds the ball.
Talk loudly about who has the ball and who has the runner.
Do not force a bad shot; move the ball and attack again.
commonMistakes: Walking the ball up after a stop.
Defenders getting caught behind the play.
Forcing a low-percentage shot instead of passing to the open player.
content.safety: Keep the sidelines clear and teams waiting at least two metres behind the baseline.
progressions: Add a fourth attacker joining after four seconds to force quick decisions.
regressions: Play half-court after each score for two possessions to slow the game down.
variations: Only allow a shot after at least one pass in the first ten seconds.
